contract.sync_assumed: caller separates consecutive calls that reuse the temp storage by a block barrier
contract.sync_performed: __syncthreads inside: 1 bracket and bin reset, 1 in the compaction scan, 1 after the compaction stores, 3 per finishing pass (histogram, scan internal, state), 1 in the emission scan, 1 before the warp finish
contract.k_range: [1, N) at run time, the bound is accepted only when the candidate count is at least k (always for k <= Threads), else the tile fallback runs
contract.n_range: N = Threads x IPT, Threads 128, 256 or 512, IPT >= 1, N <= 32768 (16-bit count fields), measured 1024 to 32768 at 256 threads
contract.type_constraints: fp32 and bf16 keys, int32 indices derived from the striped position
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN with the sign bit clear orders above +inf and is selected first, a NaN with the sign bit set orders below -inf, the all-ones pattern collides with the empty-slot sentinel of the warp finish (unsupported), never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 is folded onto +0.0 under prefer_smaller_index only (one FADD or one select per item in the prologue), kept distinct under not_guaranteed
contract.tie_break_support: not_guaranteed and prefer_smaller_index, one code path: the warp finish orders the pivot set by (key descending, index ascending), a tie class larger than 32 is taken in scan order under not_guaranteed and ranked by index passes under prefer_smaller_index, the items above the pivot set are an exact set under both
contract.sorted_output_support: not supported inherently, post-sort of k
